newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower on international worries.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower on international worries.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Friday, depressed by international worries about Europe's economic and monetary union (EMU), the French election and U.S. computer company Intel's profit warning.
The Stockholm general index closed down 0.58 percent at 2,796.49 in turnover totalling 5.71 billion crowns.
Intel's warning sent telecoms group Ericsson down to an intra-day low of 266.5 crowns but it closed at 272, down only one crown.
Power company Sydkraft jumped five crowns to 178 after releasing first quarter earnings.
Sydkraft's profit after financial items, including a 2.3 billion crown capital gain, amounted to 3.40 billion crowns compared to expectations of 3.29 billion.
Pharmacia & Upjohn rose one crown to 263. Amersham International Plc said on Friday it was considering merging its life sciences business with that of P&U.
Volvo edged down 1.5 crowns to 114.5 after touching a recond this week in heavy turnover of three million shares.
